spec_match.rationale: Opens four real WebSocket connections with and without targetAddressSpace declarations against the same-origin echo endpoint, and frames what each outcome proves against the page's own address space and scheme.

interactive.rationale: A run button drives all four attempts and fills the outcome table; verified the control opened and the option-passing rows surfaced this build's real constructor behaviour.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises attempts that say which case they demonstrate instead of assuming an HTTPS reader, which the context panel does.

edge_cases.rationale: The context panel handles scheme/secure-context/origin variation, the control-first design prevents false conclusions, and the pre-154 dictionary-as-subprotocol failure is explained precisely.

conformance.rationale: The suite's constructor-reads/option-carrier/same-origin assertions are this page's rows; on Chromium 141 it honestly ran 2 pass / 3 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): ran all four attempts — control opened; the three option rows threw the '[object Object]' subprotocol SyntaxError, and the detail correctly diagnosed that this browser does not read the dictionary at all (pre-154); console clean, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs support state and per-row outcomes.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, dl-based context panel, captioned table, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Context uses dl semantics, table has caption and scoped headers, detail is aria-live, button is 44px.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 (scrollWidth 360, screenshot read).

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/support-targetaddressspace-option-for-websockets/connect-locally/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp). All four attempts ran for real: the no-option control opened against the echo endpoint, and the option-declaring rows failed with the constructor's dictionary-as-subprotocol SyntaxError, which the page correctly identified as the pre-Chrome-154 state rather than an address-space result. The context panel's loopback-page framing keeps the epistemics honest. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; no mobile overflow; feature /conformance/ honestly ran 2 pass / 3 fail. Clears the bar.
